patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents for an annual examination and mentions noticing a pink bump on his forehead that has developed over the last month. He reports significant sun exposure throughout his life, including episodes of blistering sunburns.

Secondary_Symptoms: Rapid development over the last month

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: History of extensive sun exposure and multiple blistering sunburns. No significant past dermatological diagnoses.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Retired, spends a lot of time outdoors. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite. No other skin lesions noted.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the dermatological lesion observed on the patient's forehead.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hello, doctor. I’m 67 and I’ve noticed a pink bump on my forehead that’s been growing pretty quickly over the last month.” “I’ve had a lot of sun exposure over the years, including times when I blistered badly, but I don’t have fever, weight loss, or any other new symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like small scratches, open or raw areas, or areas where the skin looks worn down—anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Not that I can tell—no small scratches, open or raw areas, or worn-down spots anywhere else on my body.” “It’s mainly just the single pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the past month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I've never had episodes where I stop breathing or wake up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—nothing like that. I haven’t had any injury, and there’s no severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any part of my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and I haven’t seen any skin changes there compared to the other side.” “The only thing I’m concerned about is the pink bump on my forehead that’s been developing over the last month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, new discoloration or soreness on the chest area)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any new bruising, discoloration, or soreness on my chest wall.” “I’m otherwise feeling well, and it’s really only the pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the last month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—my urination frequency and volume have been about the same as usual. I feel otherwise well, and my only concern is the pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the last month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t smoke or use drugs, and I only drink alcohol socially. I haven’t taken opioids or stimulants recently, and nothing else comes to mind that would affect my health.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t have trouble controlling my urine, and I haven’t had any leaking or accidents or urgency issues. It’s only the pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the last month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only lasted a short time)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any nosebleeds, even mild ones or short episodes. The only thing I’ve noticed is the pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the past month.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk, chest, back, or belly. It’s still just the single pink bump on my forehead that’s been changing over the last month.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or thighs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs or around my calves or thighs. My main concern is still just the single pink bump on my forehead that’s been developing over the last month.”
